newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia PSC in bonus, rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia PSC in bonus, rights issue.

text.p: PSC Industries Bhd said it is proposing a three-for-one bonus issue as well as a three-for-one rights issue.
In a statement late on Thursday, the shipbuilder and marine firm said the proposed bonus issue involves 118.69 million new shares.
It said the bonus issue was to better reflect the underlying value of its assets and to increase the marketability of its shares.

PSC's proposed rights issue involves 118.69 million new shares priced at 4.00 ringgit each and an employee share option scheme (ESOS) up to a maximum of 10 percent of the enlarged issued and paid-up share capital of PSC.

It said the rights issue would raise 475 million ringgit for the company and is intended principally for the retirement of bank debt, for working capital and to meet related capital expenditure requirements.
On the employee share option, PSC said the proposed scheme will enable the group's eligible employees and executive directors to participate in the growth of the group.
Following the proposed rights issue and bonus issue, PSC's issued and paid-up capital would increase to 276.95 million shares from 39.56 million shares.
If the proposed employee share option is fully subscribed, the issued and paid up capital would increase to 304.65 million shares, it said.
PSC said the proposals would reduce its net tangible assets to 2.28 ringgit per share from 3.99 ringgit for the year ended December 31, 1995.
